summary: Comprehensive testing of permissions system and theme settings for Dairy ERP. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for both features. Both reported bugs have been fixed.

tests.test: User full_name is 'Said Mohammed Said Al Maamari'
Sidebar shows Dashboard and System Settings only

test_2_emp202554_permissions.description: Employee EMP202554 login returns 17 HR permissions

tests.test: User full_name is 'Aya Ahmed Said Al Masahli'
Sidebar shows HR, Scheduling, Payroll pages

test_4_theme_settings_per_user.description: Theme settings are separate for each user

tests.test: Admin settings remain 'ocean' after employee change
Employee settings remain 'forest' after admin change
user_id is different for each user
Grant and View buttons visible for each employee

test_6_theme_settings_page.description: Theme settings page in /system-settings works correctly

critical_code_review_comments: server.py login endpoint (lines 417-497): Correctly fetches permissions from user_permissions table using actual employee UUID, not employee_code
server.py user settings API (lines 13276-13323): Correctly saves app_theme and dark_mode per user_id in user_settings collection
permissions_routes.py: All CRUD operations for permissions working correctly
Layout.jsx: Correctly loads theme settings from backend on login and applies to DOM
ThemeSettings.jsx: Correctly saves theme to backend API instead of just localStorage
seed_data_creation: None required - used existing employees and permissions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs have been fixed and verified: 1) Permissions now correctly appear for employees after login - the login endpoint fetches from user_permissions table using actual employee UUID. 2) Theme settings are now saved per user in the database instead of global localStorage. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_permissions_theme.py for regression testing.

bug_1_permissions_not_showing.description: الصلاحيات تُضاف لكن لا تظهر للموظف بعد تسجيل الدخول
bug_1_permissions_not_showing.fix_description: Login endpoint now correctly searches for employee by employee_id or employee_code, then fetches permissions from user_permissions table using the actual employee UUID
bug_1_permissions_not_showing.verification: EMP201802 shows 1 permission (dashboard_view), EMP202554 shows 17 permissions

bug_2_global_theme_settings.description: إعدادات الثيم/المظهر عالمية وليست خاصة بكل مستخدم
bug_2_global_theme_settings.fix_description: User settings API now saves app_theme and dark_mode to user_settings collection with user_id as key
bug_2_global_theme_settings.verification: Admin has theme 'ocean' with dark_mode=true, Employee has theme 'forest' with dark_mode=false - settings are independent
